title: A more thoughtful job search
name: AI Remote Job Matching Application
description: Explore how AI could turn a long list of remote roles into a more relevant shortlist.
problem: Searching for a suitable remote role involves comparing scattered listings, reading repetitive descriptions and checking the same requirements.
solution: A proposed matching workflow extracts job requirements, compares them against a candidate-approved profile and explains each recommendation. People make the final decision.
limitations: Matching can reproduce bias, miss context and expose personal information. Any prototype needs consent, data minimisation and evaluation against a human-reviewed benchmark.
steps: Extract requirements into a consistent format

title: Find the answer. Keep the context.
name: Enterprise Document Search using RAG
description: An approach to finding useful answers across internal documents, with sources attached.
problem: Useful information often sits across folders, policies and documents. Finding the right passage can interrupt an otherwise simple task.
solution: A proposed retrieval-augmented generation workflow searches approved documents before drafting an answer, with links back to the source material.
limitations: A source citation is not proof of correctness. Permissions, stale documents, retrieval quality and unsupported answers all require explicit evaluation.
steps: Draft an answer with source references

title: A clearer view of what’s in stock
name: Business Inventory and Stock Management
description: A practical application concept for tracking stock movements and spotting replenishment needs.
problem: Disconnected spreadsheets can make it difficult to understand current stock, investigate adjustments and plan purchases.
solution: A proposed application records stock movements, maintains a clear audit history and highlights items that need attention.
limitations: This is a design exploration, not an operational inventory system. Concurrency, access controls and reconciliation need implementation and testing.
